list_forms.title: List signature forms
list_forms.description: List the signature forms in the workspace, a page at a time. Each carries its formId and its definition (formJson, including the title). The formId is what send_form takes.

filter.description: Which records to return; ALL returns everything in the workspace.

forms.description: Forms, each with formId and formJson (title and fields).

list_documents.title: List documents and PDF templates
list_documents.description: List the workspace's documents, a page at a time, each with its documentId and documentName. Pass is_stand_alone_template=true to list the reusable PDF templates that send_pdf_template sends.

filter.description: Which records to return; ALL returns everything in the workspace.

is_stand_alone_template.description: True to list PDF templates rather than one-off documents.

documents.description: Documents, each with documentId and documentName.

send_form.title: Send a form for signature
send_form.description: Email a signature form to one recipient so they can fill it in and sign. Returns an `error` field rather than an HTTP error when the form id or address is wrong.

form_id.description: Id of the form to send, from list_forms.

email.description: The email to send: {to (recipient address), subject, message}.

output.description: The dispatch result, or {error} when it was refused.

send_pdf_template.title: Send a PDF template for signature
send_pdf_template.description: Send a reusable PDF template out for signature, assigning a person to each of its roles and filling its custom variables. Returns an `error` field rather than an HTTP error when a role title does not match.

document_id.description: Id of the PDF template, from list_documents with is_stand_alone_template=true.

receivers.description: Signers, one per role on the template, each {name, email, roleTitle, roleColour} and optionally {subject, message} to override the shared email. roleTitle must match the template's role name exactly; roleColour is a hex colour such as #8FB1C8.

mail_data.description: Email used for every signer who has none of their own: {subject, message}.

custom_variables.description: Values for the template's variables, each {varName, varValue}; varName includes its square brackets, e.g. "[v1]". Variables left out are filled empty.

output.description: The dispatch result, or {error} when it was refused.

send_for_signing.title: Send a form or PDF template for signing (bulk)
send_for_signing.description: Send a form template or a PDF template for signing through BoloForms' sending endpoint, to up to 100 recipients in one request. For a PDF template, each recipient's roleTitle must match a role on the template and pdf_data can carry the PDF itself.

document_id.description: Id of the form or PDF template to send.

receivers.description: Recipients (up to 100), each {name, email} and optionally {subject, message}; for a PDF template also {roleTitle, roleColour}.

mail_data.description: Email used for every recipient who has none of their own: {subject, message}.

pdf_data.description: PDF_TEMPLATE only: the PDF as a data URI, data:application/pdf;base64,<content>.

add_webhook.title: Add a webhook
add_webhook.description: Register a webhook on the workspace, so BoloForms POSTs to your URL when the chosen event happens on the selected documents or forms. Returns the workspace owner record with every webhook registered.

webhook.description: The webhook: {webhookId (a UUID you generate), webhookName, webhookUrl, webhookEvent (the event to subscribe to), selectedDocs (ids of the documents or forms to watch), webhookStatus: "ACTIVE"}.

owner.description: Holds webhooks: every webhook registered on the workspace.

delete_webhook.title: Delete a webhook
delete_webhook.description: Remove a webhook from the workspace so BoloForms stops calling its URL.

webhook.description: The webhook to remove, as returned in owner.webhooks when it was added (it carries the webhookId).

output.description: The workspace owner record after the removal.
